title: 406/415 diagnostics / StatusCodePages / ProblemDetails
meaning: 406 Not Acceptable is response-side negotiation failure: server cannot produce a media type acceptable to the client.
415 Unsupported Media Type is request-side body media-type failure: server/action/input formatter cannot consume the request Content-Type.
StatusCodePages can provide a readable body for status-code-only responses.
ProblemDetails can be enriched with useful diagnostics, but should not leak unsafe internal implementation details.
ReasonPhrases and custom status-code endpoints can make 406/415 responses easier to understand during debugging.
boundary_notes: R02 covers Consumes/input formatter/action selection basics.
R04 covers Vary: Accept and browser Accept policy.
